---
title: "Updates"
---

This page records changes to the handbook that may be useful to students. Small corrections to spelling or formatting are not listed.

#### 2 Aug 2026

- **New:** The [Week 1 lectures](lectures/L01/index.qmd) are now available from the weekly schedule, with updated previews of the 2026 lecture slides.
- **New:** We have a snail-collecting competition! See Week 1 of the [weekly schedule](index.qmd#weekly-content) for details and a direct link to the competition page on Canvas.

#### 1 Aug 2026

- **NEW**: The [Week 1 practical](module01/102-week01.qmd) has been redesigned, and released. The workshop is now more focused, software setup instructions are shorter and the graphical examples are easier to read compared to the 2025 version.
- **NEW**: Additional demonstrator checks have been added. Damn you AI, making us work harder to ensure learning!

#### 29 Jul 2026

- **FIX**: We found a bunch of typos on the [Am I ready for BEDA?](prerequisites.qmd) page (Januar needs to proofread more...) and fixed them. That is all.

#### 28 Jul 2026

- **FIX**: The [weekly schedule](index.qmd#weekly-content) now distinguishes practice quizzes from marked assessments and shows the correct deadlines in the weeks when they are due.
- **NEW**: We are also preparing a PDF edition of the handbook for offline use; the [front page](index.qmd) and [About this handbook](about-handbook.qmd) page will provide the download when it is ready.
- **NEW**: In response to student feedback, the [Modules overview](unit-information.qmd#modules) now provides more detail about what each part of the unit covers and how the three modules connect.

#### 27 Jul 2026

- **FIX**: The [Assessments page](assessments/assessments.qmd) now shows the 2026 due dates, clearer countdowns and direct links to each assessment in Canvas.
- **NEW**: Report 2 is presented as one assessment with separate group dataset and individual report components.

#### 24 Jul 2026

Welcome to the changelog! Lots of updates (because we are migrating from the 2025 handbook).

- **FIX**: We clarified parts of the weekly schedule and added assessment weightings to the Notes column.
- **NEW**: The About page now provides clearer information about statistical software, assumed knowledge, lectures, practicals, attendance and working with your group.
- **NEW**: We "optimised" the handbook for smaller screens like that phone or tablet that you are probably reading this on...
